goal: Unify learnings storage to follow the decisions pattern: JSONL index + optional per-learning .md files in a learnings/ directory, retiring the monolithic learnings.md. Scope: update CLI (learning commands, state machine, rollup logic to support optional file field in JSONL entries + learnings/ directory), update skills (complete skill learnings synthesis to write detail files instead of appending to monolithic .md), update migration logic to convert existing learnings.md entries to per-file format.
name: learnings-directory-pattern
